tei:div.tei:p: (nya)༄༅// sgrol ma'i gsol 'debs maṇḍal bzhi pa bzhugs// ༄༅// na mo gu ru we/ srod dang tho rangs langs par byas nas// gnyis gsum bdun du mngon par brjod na// bu 'dod pas ni bu thob 'gyur zhing*// nor 'dod pas ni nor rnams nyid thob// 'dod pa thams cad thob par 'gyur te// bgegs rnams med cing so sor 'joms 'gyur// zhes pa la brten nas maṇḍal bzhi pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po la gsum/ dus dang*/ gnas dang*/ rten dang mchod pa bsham pa'o// dus ni bsod nams bsag pa yin na tshes brgyad dam nya stong lta bu la bya/ bar chad sel na/ nad rims dang*/ 'dre dang*/ chom rkun la sogs pa dang*/ pha rol gyi dmag tshogs dang*/ rmi lam ngan pa la sogs pa byung ba'i dus su'o// 'dod pa'i don bsgrub na/ nang par lta bu don sgrub pa'i do nub bya ste dus su'o// gnas ni gtsug lag khang ngam/ mchod khang la sogs pa nyams dga' bar bya'o// rten ni bla ma yi dam spyi dang*/ dkon mchog gsum gyi rten lugs ma dang*/ ras bris la sogs pa ci rigs pa dgram/ rje btsun ma'i sku lugs ma'am/ bris sku gang rung zhig bzhugs su gzhug go /mchod pa ni steng du bla re/ rnga yab la sogs pa ci rigs pas brgyan/ maṇḍal ni re kha'i maṇḍal zlum po khor yug gnyis pa bzhi bri'o// yang shing ngam 'khar ba'i maṇḍal bzhi/ gcig las med na yang bskyar la dbul/ mar me bzhi/ lha bshos bzhi/ grub na reng bu bzhi/ yon chab dang*/ dri mchog rnams grub na bzhi bzhi/ med na ci rigs pa bsham mo// me tog ni zangs gzhong la sogs par bsags la gsol ba 'debs tsa na 'thor zhing bya'o// dngos gzhi la gsum ste/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya ba dang*/ dkon mchog spyi la gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ rje btsun ma la gsol ba gdab pa'o// dang po ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog bcas la// byang chub ma thob bar du bdag skyabs mchi// bdag gis bsnyen sgrub bgyis pa 'di dag gis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog

/ces brjod la don yid la bya'o// gnyis pa dkon mchog spyi la mchod pa bya ba ni/ dang po bla ma la phyag bya/ de nas yi dam la/ de nas buddha la/ de nas byang sems la phyag bya/ de nas mchod pa dang*/ maṇḍal dang po dbul/ yan lag bdun pa rgyas pa'am bsdus pa gang rung ba cig byas la/ 'dod pa'i don gang sgrub pa de la gsol ba drag tu gdab bo// gsum pa rje btsun ma la gsol ba gdab pa la gsum ste/ dang po rje btsun ma'i rten mdun du bshams la/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas po ta la nas ye shes pa spyan drangs la gnyis su med par bstim mo// yang thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rje btsun ma'i rnam par spyan drangs la bstim mo// de nas dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bor mos par byas te/ ngag tu/ glog dang 'dra ba'i spyan mnga' ma// dpa' mo tā re tuttā re// sangs rgyas zhal gyi padma yi// ge sar las byung khyod la 'dud// ston ka'i zla ba rgyas pa yi// dkyil 'khor dang mtshungs zhal mnga' ma// mchog sbyin phyag rgya utpa la// bsnams ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// 'khor ba'i gzeb las tu re yi// swā hās nyon mongs zhi bar mdzod// oṃ gyi ngo bo nyid kyis ni// tshangs pa'i sgo 'byed khyod la 'dud// 'jigs pa chen po brgyad las ni// 'jig rten thams cad skyob par mdzad// kun gyi ma ru gyur pa yi// sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas phyag bya/ de nas mchod pa dbul ba ni ngag tu/ dri med gtsang zhing yan lag brgyad ldan chu// thang skyes chu skyes chu chen me tog bcas// dri zhim yid 'ong mchod yon dam pa 'di// rgyal ba skyed pa'i yum la mchod par bgyi// gu ru tā rā badzra arghaṃ pū dza āḥhūm̐/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i dbu la mchod 'bul ma// puṣpe dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// thang skyes chu skyes me tog bkod mang bsnams// rgyal ba skyed pa'i yum la mchod par bgyi// gu ru tā rā badzra puṣpe pū dza āḥhūm̐/

dus gsum rgyal ba'i shangs la mchod 'bul ma// spos ma dud kha zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// lhan skyes sbyar dang spos gyur spos khang bsnams// rgyal ba skyed pa'i yum la mchod par bgyi// gu ru tā rā badzra dhū pe pū dza āḥhūm̐/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyan la mchod 'bul ma// dī paṃ dmar skya zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// nyi zla rin chen snang gsal sna tshogs bsnams// rgyal ba skyed pa'i yum la mchod par bgyi// gu ru tā rā badzra ā lo ke pū dza sāḥhūm̐/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs la mchod 'bul ma// dri ma ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// a kar tsandan ga pur dung chos bsnams// rgyal ba skyed pa'i yum la mchod par bgyi// gu ru tā rā badzra gandhe pū dza āḥhūm̐/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i ljags la mchod 'bul ma// ro ma dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// ro dang bcud ldan lha rdzas zhal zas bsnams// rgyal ba skyed pa'i yum la mchod par bgyi// gu ru tā rā badzra nai wi dye pū dza āḥhūm̐/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i snyan la mchod 'bul ma// sgra ma sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// pi wang gling bu sil snyan sna tshogs bsnams// rgyal ba skyed pa'i yum la mchod par bgyi// gu ru tā rā badzra shapta pū dza āḥhūm̐/ sa gzhi spos kyis byugs shing chag chag btab// ri rab gling bzhis legs par brgyan pa 'di// sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs nas phul ba yis// 'gro kun rnam dag zhing du skye bar shog /gu ru tā rā badzra maṇḍal pū dza āḥhūm̐/ de nas rje btsun ma la blo bkal ba'i dad gus kyi bsam pa rtse gcig pas bstod pa tshar gnyis gdon/ de nas dge slong ma dpa' mos mdzad pa'i yan lag bdun pa tshar gcig bya ste/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma dang*// phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yi// rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad la// kun nas dang bas phyag 'tshal lo// me tog bdug spos mar me dri// zhal zas rol mo la sogs pa// dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul nas 'bul// 'phags ma'i tshogs kyis bzhes su gsol// thog ma med nas da lta'i bar// mi dge bcu dang mtshams med lnga// sems ni nyon mongs dbang gyur pa'i// sdig pa thams cad bshags par bgyi// nyan thos rang rgyal byang chub sems// so so skye bo la sogs pa'i// rgyu dang 'bras bus bsdus pa yi// bsod nams la ni bdag yi rang*// sems can rnams kyi bsam pa dang*// blo yi bye brag ji lta bar// che chung thun mong theg pa yi// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol// 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs bar// mya ngan mi 'da' thugs rje yis// sdug bsngal rgya mtshor bying ba yi// sems can rnams la gzigs su gsol// bdag gis bsod nams ci bsags pa// thams cad byang chub rgyur gyur nas// ring por mi thogs 'gro ba yi// 'dren pa'i dpal du bdag gyur cig

/ces pa'i yan lag bdun pa bya'o// de nas rang dang mdun gyi rje btsun ma dmigs pa gsal bar byas la/ rtsa sngags yi ge bcu pa sum brgya bgrang ngo*// de yang nad zhi bar 'dod na oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re sarba gra he bhyaḥshāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod/ de bzhin du gdon zhi bar 'dod na/ sarba duṣṭān bhyaḥshāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod/ bgegs zhi bar 'dod na sarba bighnā na bhyaḥshāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod/ rims nad zhi bar 'dod na sarba dzwa re bhyaḥshāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ dus min 'chi ba la/ a kā la mṛ tyū/ ltas ngan pa la/ durmī ta/ rmi lam ngan pa la/ durso pni/ rnam g.yeng la/ tsitta ku le bhyaḥ zhes brjod/ dgra dang chom rkun nyer 'tshe zhi bar 'dod na/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re sarba u pa dra be bhyaḥshāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod/ de nas rje btsun ma la rtse gcig tu dmigs la yi ge gnyis kyi sbyor ba bla ma kha che ba'i gdams ngag tā re zhes pa sum brgya brjod/ de nas maṇḍal phul la gsol ba gdab ste/ rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma thugs rje can// bdag dang mtha' yas sems can thams cad kyi// sgrib gnyis byang nas tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs te// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'thob par mdzad du gsol// de ma thob kyi tshe rabs kun tu yang*// lha dang mi yi bde ba mchog thob nas// thams cad mkhyen pa sgrub par byed pa yi// bar chad gdon bgegs rims dang nad la sogs// dus min 'chi bar gyur ba sna tshogs dang*// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan pa dang*// 'jigs pa brgyad sogs nye bar 'tshe ba rnams// myur du zhi zhing med par mdzad du gsol// 'jig rten 'jig rten las ni 'das pa yi// bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs pa rnams// 'phel zhing rgyas nas bsam pa'i don rnams kun// 'bad med lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol// sgrub la brtson zhing dam chos 'phel ba dang*// rtag tu khyed sgrub zhal mchog mthong ba dang*// stong nyid don rtogs byang sems rin po che// yar ngo'i zla bzhin 'phel rgyas mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba gdab/

rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzang zhing dga' ba der// padma dam pa shin tu mdzes las skyes// snang ba mtha' yas rgyal bas mngon sum du// lung bstan pa yang bdag gis der thob shog /bkra shis ni/ bdag gis tshes rabs kun nas bsgrubs pa'i lha// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las ma// sngo ljang zhal gcig phyag gnyis myur zhing dpa'// yum gyur utpa la bsnams ma'i bkra shis shog /rje btsun ma la gsol 'debs maṇḍal dang mchod pa tshar gsum du dbul ba las dang po'o// gnyis pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ 'jig rten gsum mgon yum gyur spyan yangs ma// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad skyed pa'i yum// gnyis med ye shes ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// thugs rje'i dbang gis 'gro don sna tshogs mdzad// byams pa'i yum gyur khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// sku mdog ljang gus phrin las sna tshogs mdzod// yon tan rab rgyas bcu drug lon pa'i tshul// 'gro la rab dges zhal ni 'dzum pa dang*// zhi ba'i spyan gyis 'jig rten gsum la gzigs// thugs rje che mnga' khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// byang sems rang bzhin zla ba gdan du bting*// nyon mongs mi bskyod rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs// sgrib pa kun spangs padma'i gdan la bzhugs// zag med bde rgyas zla ba'i rgyab yol can// zag med bde ba che la phyag 'tshal lo// na bza' mchog dang rin chen du mas spras// phyag g.yas mchog sbyin sgrub la dngos grub ster// g.yon pa utpal skyon bral dag pa'i rtags// phyag gnyis thabs dang shes rab zung du 'brel// mtha' bral zung 'jug sku la phyag 'tshal lo// de nas gong ma bzhin mchod 'bul byas la/ bstod pa tshar gsum bton la/ yan lag bdun pa nas bkra shis kyi bar sngar dang 'dra/ rje btsun ma'i maṇḍal dang mchod pa gnyis pa'o// gsum pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ thugs rje chen po sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag stong spyan stong sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// sman pa'i rgyal po sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// thugs rje thabs mkhas sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// sa ltar brtag gyur sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// chu ltar bsil gyur sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// me ltar smin mdzad sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// rlung ltar rgyas mdzad sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas phyag 'tshal lo// mchod dbul gong dang 'dra/

de nas bstod pa tshar bdun gdon/ yan lag bdun pa sngar dang 'dra/ de nas rtsa sngags la gang zhi bar 'dod pa'i spel tshig btags la stong du kha tshang bar bya ba'i phyir bzhi brgya bgrang ngo*// gong ma bzhin yi ge gnyis kyi sbyor ba tā re zhes pa bzhi brgya bgrang ngo*// de nas maṇḍal tha ma dbul/ rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma thugs rje can// zhes pa nas/ bkra shis kyi bar sngar dang 'dra ste maṇḍal bzhi pa'o// mthar mchod dbul bya ba dang*/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ bkra shis kyi bar la long yod cing spros pa la dga' na dbyangs su grub na'ang dga'o// ma grub na tshigs bcad kyis kyang btub bo// mjug dge ba bsngo ba ni/ bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di la brten nas sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sku gsum yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa myur du thob nas/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po myur du skems par gyur cig sems can ma bsgral ba rnams sgrol ba'i mthu thogs pa med pa dang ldan par gyur cig sems can ma grol ba rnams dgrol ba'i mthu thogs pa med pa dang ldan par gyur cig sems can mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams mya ngan las zlo bar byed pa'i mthu thogs pa med pa dang ldan par gyur cig dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bslab pa'i gzhi mtha' dag la rjes su slob cing*/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po che spyad pa la mthu thogs pa med pa dang ldan par gyur cig sgrol ma'i maṇḍal bzhi pa'i gsol 'debs rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'o// //ithi// gtor ma bzhi bshams pa'i dang po bcom ldan 'das sgrol ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas bskor ba la dbul/ gnyis pa chos skyong la phul la phrin las gzhol/ gsum pa rigs drug kun la sbyin/ bzhi pa gzhi bdag la tshim par sbyin no// 'di bris dge bas rje btsun ma// mnyes nas bdag gi sdig sgrib rnams// bsal nas 'gro ba'i don du ni// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myur thob shog
/maṅga laṃ// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
